name: Comic Con Revolution
blurb: SoCal comic and pop-culture convention in Ontario, California, with comic-book creators, artists, and film and TV guests.

editions.evidence: Page text: 'CCR TICKETS ON SALE NOW! • MAY 22 & 23 2027 • The Ontario Convention Center | 2000 E Convention Center Way, Ontario, CA 91764' and 'CCR turns 10. SoCal's fan favorite comic & pop culture experience returns for its huge 10th Anniversary!'

notes: extract.mjs's guests-page render only exposed one guest caption (Cam Clarke, candidate #12, a hover/active-slide box); the other 8 guest photos (candidates #3-11) carried no on-page text in that snapshot because their caption boxes are off until that slide is active. Confirmed all 9 names and their full credit text directly from the page via WebFetch (which reads the underlying HTML regardless of carousel state); names also match the Last_First.jpg filename pattern seen on each photo (e.g. Clarke_Cam.jpg = Cam Clarke, confirmed against the one caption extract.mjs did capture). Long on-card credit lists were trimmed to short known-for phrases per the schema; full original text is quoted in this research note for Cam Clarke and Sting via the evidence/notes above and can be re-pulled from the live guests page if needed. 2026-10-05 re-verify: current, lineup unchanged -- re-fetched the page's HTML directly (same carousel-caption limitation reproduced in extract.mjs's render); all nine names and credits match exactly, the only year text on the page is 'MAY 22 & 23 2027', and there is no cancelled/archive section. Refute attempt (2026-10-05): refuted -> none-yet -- the guest photos live in a flat, undated, brand-wide '_images/_guests/' folder with no per-edition tag anywhere, and an independent search confirms all nine names (Cam Clarke, Townsend Coleman, Scott Hanna, Renae Jacobs, Rob Paulsen, Whilce Portacio, John Romita Jr., Sting, Alan Tudyk) were the published guests of the May 16-17, 2026 Comic Con Revolution Ontario, which ended under 5 months before this check, so the page is that show's still-live roster behind a bumped 'MAY 22 & 23 2027' ticket banner; guests set to none-yet and the lineup removed.
